verdict.rationale: Mem0's own CLI documents deleting memories from the terminal, and webhooks fire on memory deletion events, so on-demand deletion of individual memories exists. Nothing documents deleting all of one entity's memories or erasing an account entirely for privacy compliance. Memory expiration does not count, since the docs say 'Nothing is deleted.' Missing for 10: documented per-entity (user_id/agent_id) bulk deletion, full-erasure/account-wipe capability, privacy/GDPR deletion guarantees, API-level delete documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can delete a user's memories on demand — single memory, per-entity, or full erasure — to satisfy privacy requirements

citations.quote: The mem0 CLI lets you add, search, list, update, and delete memories directly from the terminal.
You can configure webhooks to send HTTP POST requests to your specified URLs whenever memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized.
